y9-11d-q12i.topicTitle: The equation of a straight line
y9-11d-q12i.question: Rewrite the equation \(x = -3y\) in the form \(y = mx + c\) and write down the gradient and \(y\)-intercept. Format: y = [eq], m = [val], c = [val]
y9-11d-q12i.title: Rewrite the equation x = -3y in the form...
y9-11d-q12i.solution:
Rearrange the equation to isolate \(y\):
\(x = -3y\) becomes \(y = -\frac{1}{3}x\).

From this form:
- Gradient \(m = -\frac{1}{3}\)
- \(y\)-intercept \(c = 0\).
y9-11d-q12i.hint: Solve the equation for \(y\) to write it in the form \(y = mx + c\).
